answer: Re-attestations are stored in jetty and reef lists each lapse. Standing lapses unless 5 peers re-attest it every 18 epochs, which means holding a position requires ongoing relationships rather than a one-time purchase. A farm cannot self-supply those as the attesters must be independent on the tide graph. Verification costs 7 dollars and 2 days per identity, which turns a 1384 account sybil into a 2 million dollar project with no guaranteed return. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
